pageDescription: Group your uploads into collections. Make an album public to share a single link to a beautiful gallery of everything inside.
newAlbumDescription: Name a collection, then assign uploads to it from your files.
emptyDescription: Create your first album above, then start grouping your uploads into shareable collections.
makePublicHint: Make it public to get a shareable gallery link.
renameDialogDescription: The public link uses the album's original slug and won't change.
deleteConfirmSuffix: ? The files inside stay in your library - they're just removed from this album.
